items.html: *Know that in every world of ABYA there are in it essentiality (Atzmut) and vessels (Kelim). And the essentiality is divided into five aspects — the inner NRNHY (Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, Chaya, Yechida) — and two surrounding [lights] (Makifin): Chaya and Yechida. And this is called the essentiality of the lights. And this essentiality is clothed within the vessels. And just as the essentiality is divided into the inner and the surrounding over it, the surrounding being greater than the inner, so are the vessels divided into two — the outer and the inner — and the outer is greater than the inner. Except that afterward, through the adhesion of the inner light (Or Pnimi) to the inner vessel, it becomes more refined than the outer vessel.
